result.question: Will the $500K pre-seed close within ~2 quarters? Probability, likely lead, rough terms, timeline.

report.question: Will the $500K pre-seed close within ~2 quarters? Probability, likely lead, rough terms, timeline.

prediction.headline: Partial soft-circle (~$365K, ~73% of target) is the modal outcome; a full $500K priced close in-horizon is unlikely. BFTP anchors, Robin Hood fills, but proof gates leave a ~$135K gap unfilled.
prediction.likely_lead: Ben Franklin Technology Partners (C&N PA) — the only warm institutional door and the explicit anchor; $150K indicative, with statewide BFTP matching $100K behind it. Robin Hood Ventures ($100K) syndicates on the warm BFTP intro but explicitly caps at a partial fill.
prediction.terms_estimate: Priced preferred at repriced ~$3.5M-$4.0M pre-money (down from the aggressive $5M ask, toward the walkaway band given pre-revenue / 0 customers). At a $365K raise on ~$3.75M pre that is ~8.9% dilution; a full $500K would be ~11-13%. Realistically structured as a smaller priced round or a SAFE/note bridge to preserve the cap table until proof lands.
prediction.timeline: BFTP anchor + angel fill can soft-circle within the 2-quarter window (stances firmed to 'engaged' by Round 2-3), but a full priced close slips beyond ~2 quarters because the data-loss blocker (YGGDATA-258), SOC 2 Type 1, and the absent pilot/LOI pipeline gate the VC tranche. Expect first-close on the BFTP+RHV portion in-horizon, final close past horizon.

report.causal_narrative: The raise advanced only as far as its single warm institutional door allowed: BFTP's anchor signal pulled in statewide BFTP, Robin Hood, and the Mid-Atlantic angel connector ($365K committed-indicative), but contagion stopped dead at the econ-dev/angel boundary. Every Tier-2 VC held its evidence gate — Schematic needs manufacturer conversations, Ironspring/Differential need customer-discovery and a data-infra deck, DataTribe and Work-Bench need SOC 2 and enterprise design partners, Stage 2 needs paid LOIs — and none cleared because the critical YGGDATA-258 data-loss blocker stayed open and proof points stayed at zero. Momentum inverted in Round 4 (+0.27 to -0.04) and committed capital actually receded from $425K to $365K, signaling the soft-circle firming as a partial rather than building toward a full close. The narrative tailwind and influencer warmth are real but thin channels that amplify attention without converting into hard checks absent a demo artifact or closed blocker.

coalitions.name: Regional econ-dev anchor bloc
coalitions.role: Anchor + match; the spine of any close. Statewide is contingent on C&N anchoring and a PA-jobs/match story.

coalitions.name: Angel fill + amplification
coalitions.role: Fills behind the BFTP anchor on warm intro; angel connector makes downstream intros but does not raise conviction without proof.

coalitions.name: Stalled evidence-gated VCs
coalitions.role: Contagion firewall. All held curious/skeptical/interested; each gate (manufacturer demand, customer discovery, SOC 2, enterprise design partners, paid LOIs) remained shut, so zero VC capital materialized.

swing_factors.why: It is cited verbatim as a live blocker by BFTP C&N, Robin Hood, Ironspring, DataTribe, and 640 Oxford. Closing it is the single highest-leverage unlock — it would convert RHV from partial-fill to full, and potentially open one Tier-2 gate, materially lifting the close probability.

swing_factors.factor: First paid pilot / signed design-partner LOI
swing_factors.why: Zero pilots and zero LOIs cap RHV, hard-gate Stage 2 and Work-Bench, and block Schematic/Ironspring's demand thesis. A single paid engagement would validate the GTM-is-moat and demand gates that currently keep $0 of VC capital in play.

Directly gates DataTribe (would-be security lead) and reinforces Work-Bench skepticism. Less broadly load-bearing than the data-loss blocker, but unlocks the cyber/enterprise lane that is fully closed today.

swing_factors.factor: Valuation reprice to the $3.5M-$4M walkaway band
swing_factors.why: The $5M pre ask is flagged aggressive for a pre-revenue solo founder. Repricing is largely priced-in by Round 4 and is necessary to keep BFTP/RHV engaged; failure to reprice risks the partial soft-circle slipping to a stall.

1 FTE is the binding constraint and 9-month runway. The founder cannot close blockers, run customer discovery, and run a raise simultaneously — capacity contention is why momentum stalled in Round 4 and why the timeline slips past horizon.

caveats: Committed figures are indicative interest, not signed term sheets — every 'engaged' check (BFTP C&N, statewide, RHV, angel) is conditioned on closing the data-loss blocker and/or a match/proof story, so the $365K is soft and could erode further if blockers persist (Round 4 already showed capital receding from $425K to $365K).

The $365K modal outcome falls ~$135K (27%) short of the $500K target; whether this counts as a 'close' depends on definition — it is a credible partial first-close but not a full priced round in-horizon.

Solo-founder, 9-month runway, $5,150/mo burn: capacity contention between blocker remediation, customer discovery, and the raise is the structural reason momentum stalled. A slip past 2 quarters also pressures runway.
No Tier-2 VC moved at all across 4 rounds — if the synthesis assumed any VC contagion it would be unsupported; the close, if it happens, is entirely regional-econ-dev + angel, with no priced-VC lead.
Valuation is modeled at the repriced $3.5M-$4M band, not the $5M ask; if the founder holds firm at $5M pre, probability of even the partial close drops.
Probabilities are calibrated to a thin, single-door pipeline; the favorable AI-readiness tailwind (~0.65) is a narrative tailwind only and does not substitute for the missing proof points.

round_log.stimulus: Round 1 — BFTP activation: founder converts the open BFTP (C&N) thread into a meeting, presents the tightened 'operational substrate' memo + clean-tenant demo, and explicitly requests an investment/grant path plus 2-3 investor and pilot intros. (Realistic now; only warm door.)

Round 2 — Proof + warm-intro fan-out: founder lands 2-3 manufacturer/customer-discovery conversations and closes the critical YGGDATA-258 data-loss blocker, then uses BFTP intro to open Robin Hood Ventures and the Mid-Atlantic angel connector with an updated memo showing pipeline. (Plausible escalation; modest proof.)

Round 3 — Soft-circle forming: BFTP signals an anchor commitment (investment/grant), Robin Hood opens diligence, and 1-2 design-partner LOIs land; founder circulates a soft-circled-lead update to Tier-2 names (Differential, 640 Oxford, Ironspring) with variant decks. (Escalates only if Round 2 produced real signal.)

Round 4 — Close-or-partial: anchor + angel fill toward $300K-$500K with revised terms (pre-money likely negotiated toward $3.5M-$4M walkaway band given pre-revenue); if proof/blockers lag, outcome is a partial soft-circle / extended timeline rather than a full priced close in-horizon. (Realistic terminal state, not assumed success.)
